name: failover-without-controller
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). At 10 s the controller is detached (it sees nothing and sends nothing). B stops at 14 s. A still fails over to D, and C keeps accepting and acknowledging readings (the ACKs come from C). At 32 s the controller is attached again, learns of the failover from the repeated report and the topology, and installs a route that matches. No buffering: reports sent while detached are lost.
